comment: Truth tier for GPU output (Ross, 2026-11-17; LOG entries 2026-11-17 and
2026-11-18). At pixel spacing <= 2^crossoverSpacingLog2, GPU tiles are
judged against BigInt truth for every pixel (src/truth.mjs) instead of
the pinned f64-direct anchor, by the same statistical tier with the same
budgets (anchor.json statisticalBudgets): only the reference changes.
the fixed corpus): through 2^-37 (z32 at 200 px tiles) the anchor is
closer to truth than the G3 kernel on every view; from 2^-38 (z33) it
is not, and it fails the tier against truth on half the views. z33 at
200 px is 2^-37.99, hence the half-step boundary.
extraBudgets: absolute bounds on top of the tier (counts moved, exact
share). null = report only: chaotic long-orbit views move most counts
for any finite-precision renderer (the anchor itself moves 45% of
escapers at z28), so no absolute bound separates a re-roll from a bug;
see the 2026-11-18 LOG entry. Tightening is in policy; loosening any
budget, here or in anchor.json, is held for Ross.
seed: the sample seed for --samples N runs; changing it re-samples.
